messages:
Mike S: Hey team — FluxMetrics is ready to sign for the POC but procurement pushed back on the MSA/DPA redlines and wants the PO and signed MSA in the same envelope. They also asked for customer-managed KMS and a stricter SLA for latency. Need guidance on redlines + signature routing. I attached their redline (Flux-Redline-MSADPA.pdf).

Raj - SE: Quick note from the POC tests — Dedicated can meet their 99.9% token latency under our proposed config. For POC maybe we offer a short-term SLA (best-effort + monitoring) and reserve the strict SLOs for production.

Natalie (Legal): Looking. Two immediate things: we shouldn't accept customer-managed KMS on hosted Redwood. We can offer BYOK only for Private/on-prem. For hosted/Dedicated we can offer an HSM-managed key with additional security addendum. Also: combining PO + MSA in one envelope is fine but need separate signature blocks and execution order agreed.

Natalie (Legal): Suggested redline snippet — replacing the KMS clause with our preferred language:
```
- Customer may require Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) for all Hosted services.
+ For Hosted Services, encryption keys will be managed by Redwood KMS (FIPS/HSM-backed). Customer may request EKM integration for Dedicated or Private deployments subject to a separate security addendum and engineering feasibility review.
```

Jen F: On payment terms: FluxMetrics requested Net90. Standard is Net30; we can approve Net45 after credit review for mid-market. For enterprise (multi-year or high ARR) we can accept Net60 with exec approval. Confirming we can escalate for Net45 if sales puts it in quote.

Lisa-SalesOps: DocuSign/process note: DocuSign can include both MSA and PO in one envelope, but signer order & separate signature blocks are required. If the customer insists procurement signs first, we can flip order, but legal prefers MSA signed before invoicing. I can set signer order: Legal -> Procurement -> Exec, or Legal -> Exec -> Procurement depending on what we agree. @Natalie (Legal) which do you prefer?

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope template suggestion: template_id=tpl_7a2f. Default flow: MSA first, then PO. Can create envelope and assign routing behaviors (parallel/serial). Link: https://docusign.example.com/env/tpl_7a2f

Mike S: Customer insists procurement signs first due to their internal workflow. If we require MSA before invoice, will procurement sign a placeholder PO until MSA is final?

Natalie (Legal): We can accept procurement-first only if the PO explicitly references an unsigned MSA and includes a condition: "Execution of the MSA is required prior to invoice payment." Add conditional wording in the PO. I'll draft the clause.

sec-bot: Security flag: FluxMetrics requested EU-only data residency and EKM/HSM controls. For hosted we can provision EU-region tenancy and update DPA; EKM/HSM integration is only available for Dedicated/Private. Also, attach our SOC2 Type II link and encryption whitepaper: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2 and https://redwood.example.com/security/ekm-guide

Raj - SE: For the POC we can spin up an EU-dedicated sandbox (short-term) and limit dataset to anonymized inputs. That should address their residency concerns during the trial. I'll prepare an infra runbook and the sample request payloads.

Jen F: Action for billing — if they sign Net45 we need a credit hold clause and invoice milestone at delivery. Also require procurement to acknowledge SLA caveats for POC in the order form.

Lisa-SalesOps: I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope. Plan: create MSA + Order Form (PO) in one envelope, set conditional routing so that if procurement signs first the PO contains the conditional payment clause Natalie will draft. Will tag envelope: Flux-PO-0426 and assign env id after creation.

Natalie (Legal): I'll post the final redline language by EOD today and add the PO conditional payment clause.

Mike S: Great — next steps: Natalie drafts redline + PO clause, Jen confirms Net45 approval path, Lisa prepares DocuSign envelope with conditional routing, Raj builds EU sandbox for POC and shares runbook. I'll update the customer once we have redline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Lisa-SalesOps: on it, creating task in Salesforce and will cc billing ops.

Jen F: I'll kick off credit review.

Natalie (Legal): On it, sending redline in thread when ready.

Mike S: Thanks — I'll wait for redline then sync with FluxMetrics tomorrow morning.
